title: Replication package: Normalisation as implicit re-weighting in multi-criteria portfolio selection: closed form and cost against an exact Pareto frontier

creators.name: Azancort Neto, Julio Leite
creators.affiliation: Instituto de Tecnologia, Universidade Federal do Para (UFPA), Belem, PA, Brazil

description:
Replication package for Normalisation as implicit re-weighting in multi-criteria portfolio selection: closed form and cost against an exact Pareto frontier (under review at Omega, Elsevier).

Contents: (i) input data for 389 admissible landfill sites on Fogo Island, Cabo Verde; (ii) pre-registration documents for six sub-experiments and the main factorial including E7 kappa sweep (PRESPEC_E1-E6, PRESPEC_R1, PRESPEC_E7_KAPPA, PRESPEC_E7_KAPPA_A1); (iii) pre-computed Monte Carlo results (6 kappa values: 25, 50, 100, 200, 400, 1000; 500 draws per kappa; 22/22 gates PASS); (iv) bootstrap contrast files; (v) Python scripts to reproduce all experiments, bootstrap analyses, LaTeX macros, and manuscript figures; (vi) LaTeX manuscript source (v1.7, §7.x kappa sensitivity added).

Key finding: Normalisation is the dominant driver of Pareto attainment. The SAW-TOPSIS aggregation contrast decreases monotonically with kappa (+21.1 pp at kappa=25, equivalent to zero at kappa=200, -9.0 pp at kappa=1000); the crossover falls in [170, 240].

Changelog v1.7 (2026-11-01): E7 kappa sweep completed (6 values, 500 draws, 22/22 gates); §7.x on dependence on weight-draw dispersion added; DEV-E7-001 closed (mc_2cube_fixed.py confirmed correct source for Table 5; Gate G1 failure was a seed issue, not a scorer bug); gate code fixed (pandas StringDtype astype guard + assert); mc_2cube_and_4thcell.py deprecated (raise RuntimeError); macros_e7.tex added (36 bootstrap intervals); PRESPEC_E7_KAPPA.md amended with TOST margin delta=2.5 pp.
